newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money market rates and guilders stable.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money market rates and guilders stable.

text.p: Dutch money market rates and the Dutch guilder were stable on Tuesday and dealers foresaw little movement in the coming days.
Call money was bid at an unchanged 3.12 percent and three-month deposits were stable at 3.14 percent bid.
The guilder was trading at 112.445 per 100 marks from 112.45 onMonday.
Dealers said that investors were likely more interested in the Dutch reopened February 2007 bond than business in the money market. Business was thin.
